scene: Spinning the star projector reveals three glowing transit gates across the dome.
picture: A flat side view along a level dome platform. Far left, the rotated star projector beams light upwards. Left sits a clear glass elevator tube with open doors. The South Asian girl in her purple wheelchair rests left of centre. Centre waits a polished steam train with puffing smokestack. Right, an anchored miniature airship floats beside an arched open portal.
shown: A cylindrical glass elevator on the left, glowing with aquatic blue light.
A brass mini steam train parked along tracks in the centre.
A small striped airship docked at an open portal on the right.

variants.scene: The brass projector beams three starry portals onto the cosmic dome above.
Constellation gates shimmer overhead while you ponder your search for {quest}.
Three glowing arches sparkle across the starlit ceiling of the observatory.
